approved.history: 2026-10-29 morning: the two-piece option (old ring plus a separate dia 12 retaining disc and M2 x 10) was shown first; Shawn asked for one piece. To keep the jaw spring-in bend unchanged the first cup kept everything inboard of the old ring end (y -37.5) by cutting the boss back 2 mm; that left a 1.5 mm plate with a 0.6 mm lip, which failed to print three times on the Elegoo (IMG_7204, IMG_7205). Shawn questioned the thinness and the space: the seat between the yellow lower shell and the black jaw support is about 10 mm long along the axis (bore r 7.3 at y -39.5..-37.5 and -36.0..-35.5, r 8.4 between and beyond), and without a ring the dia 10 boss rattles 2.3 mm per side in it. The cup now fills the seat: sleeve over the uncut boss to its end at y -37.0, 3.3 mm solid bottom to y -33.5, 6.1 mm overall, M2 x 10 from outside. It is fitted after the jaw is sprung in (dropped into the open lower half-seat and slid onto the boss before the jaw support goes on), so the spring-in bend stays as before; the boss is not cut.

geometry.says: the cup ends at y -33.5: 6.1 mm long, inside the 10 mm seat, 3 mm short of the lower shell feature at y -30.5
outer diameter 14 like the old sleeve, no flange (the old flange was dia 16.4)
the boss is not cut: the as-built jaw keeps its printed boss end at y -37.0 and only the hole is drilled to 2.5
